## Exit criteria

- Read-only, concurrent-write and interrupted-publication invariants hold.

## Risks

Create the complete memory skill helper package and implement strict record/config decoding with standard-library validation, supported versions, identity, type/state, chronology, required metadata and safe operation dispatch. Empty and backend-disabled projects remain valid.

| Dependencies | TASK-002, TASK-003, TASK-005 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Do not expose a partial skill package to the Template watcher; retain the execution baseline control until the package is complete.

### Acceptance criteria

- All five record types and non-Task origins validate; malformed identifiers, unsupported YAML/schema/type/state and unresolved required values fail without writes.
- Skill metadata, dispatch and documented defaults form a complete installable package; example records are clearly non-active.

### Planned verification

- Run focused valid/invalid record and configuration fixture tests.
- Import and run core validation with only the Python standard library available.

### Risks

- A read-like backend command may write during initialization; public inspection must avoid it unless certified by the pilot.

## TASK-011 - Implement lifecycle transactions and correction recovery

Implement supersede/retract and exact journal recovery with attributable operation IDs, pre/post hashes, retained reasons and idempotent retries. Apply the same scoped discipline to authorized privacy redaction; reject automatic schema migrations.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-007, REQ-018, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-026, REQ-058 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/memory_publish.py, SKILLS-depo/memory/scripts/memory_recovery.py, MEMORY-depo/publication-and-recovery.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-010 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Recovery journals may hold the sole copy of accepted work; they must never be classed as disposable retrieval products.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every multi-record interruption reports actual committed records and resolves without duplicate identity, missing reason or silent half-supersession.
- Recovery touches only its memory operation; optional capture repair cannot reopen or replay a Task, and correction cannot silently destroy historical records.

### Planned verification

- Inject faults at each journal/record/receipt boundary, then retry the same operation and compare hashes/history.
- Test stale journal, changed human content, active lock and redaction scope failures; verify fail-closed behavior.

## TASK-012 - Implement classified maintenance boundaries

Implement explicit maintenance manifests and reindex/recovery boundaries. Classify projection, normalization, index and model caches separately from backend configuration, pending accepted writes and durable maintenance receipts.

### Risks

- Do not ignore or delete the whole .sys4ai tree; path classification is an enforceable input to maintenance.

### Acceptance criteria

- Only declared rebuildable products can be replaced/removed; unknown or sole-copy durable state blocks cleanup.
- Maintenance never touches .sys4ai/template-update or role-transition recovery and never runs as an inspection side effect.

### Planned verification

- Plant unclassified files, pending accepted writes and unrelated recovery sentinels before rebuild.
- Verify permitted cache deletion/rebuild preserves every canonical note and receipt, and reads leave maintenance state unchanged.
